description: Show what a commit changed, in PlainHub's diff view. Use it after a commit when the user wants to review the change in the browser. Hands the saved token to https://app.plainhub.dev unless noAuth is true. Example: {"repo": "octocat/hello-world", "sha": "1a2b3c4", "path": "src/login.js"}

noAuth.description: Set to true to not hand the saved token to the page

repo.description: GitHub repository as owner/name, e.g. octocat/hello-world

name: plainhub_diff
